stem.text: Objects with different masses are placed on the horizontal surface of a table. The objects are then raised to different heights above the table. The gain in gravitational potential energy of each object is the same.
Which graph best shows the variation of the height $h$ of the objects above the table with their mass $m$?

A.alt: Graph with h on the vertical axis and m on the horizontal axis, showing a curve that starts high on the vertical axis and falls towards the horizontal axis.

B.alt: Graph with h on the vertical axis and m on the horizontal axis, showing a straight line rising from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with h on the vertical axis and m on the horizontal axis, showing a horizontal line above the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph with h on the vertical axis and m on the horizontal axis, showing a curve rising from the origin and becoming steeper.
